required: one exact settlement identity and expected revision
commandBoundary.strictness: Unknown fields, malformed identities, non-lowercase hashes, implicit confirmation, and stale or unavailable plans fail before transaction work.
commandBoundary.authorization: Only the GM may cross the commit boundary; principal authority remains server-owned and is bound to exact replay.

completePlan.completeness: Every provider must be complete, the outcome must contain one Encounter Document successor, and cleanup must contain one authoritative encounter-end lifecycle result.
completePlan.documentOwnership: Experience, loot, and capture may change only allocations; outcomes may change only persistent consequences; cleanup cannot rewrite settlement orchestration fields.
completePlan.rewardRevalidation: All provider destination writes merge by exact destination authority and are re-run through the complete P8-074 reward validator before commit.
completePlan.eligibilityRevalidation: The merged settlement is re-run through the P8-072 complete-current eligibility evaluator before terminalization.

aggregateWrites.sheetMerge: Multiple providers targeting one sheet use a deterministic three-way JSON merge from the same exact previous document. Disjoint changes become one successor revision; divergent writes to one leaf fail closed.
aggregateWrites.groupMerge: Each group inventory successor is revision and hash bound to the exact P8-076 loot authority.
aggregateWrites.mapAndEncounter: Outcome and cleanup successors retain their own exact before hash, after hash, and monotonic revision.
aggregateWrites.settlement: One final settlement successor marks consequences, rewards, allocations, cleanup, receipts, and completion accepted at the same campaign minute.
aggregateWrites.preservation: Aggregate sheet cleanup and reward writes retain HP, injuries, persistent conditions, inventory or equipment not explicitly awarded, and durable advancement.

lockedAuthority.rule: The repository acquires BEGIN IMMEDIATE, checks exact replay first, then rebuilds the complete authority snapshot while the write lock is held.
coverage: all consulted sheet and group documents
all reward destination writes and permissions
lockedAuthority.staleRule: Any authority-hash, revision, definition-hash, completion, or campaign-clock drift rejects the whole command before its first durable successor.

transaction.engine: One synchronous SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction owns Encounter Document, map, sheet, group inventory, settlement, operation, history, and attention writes.
writeOrder: one merged successor per changed sheet
one successor per changed group inventory
transaction.postWriteChecks: Every domain document is reloaded or returned from its normalizing repository and must match the planned exact after hash before commit.
transaction.rollback: An error after any individual write or immediately before COMMIT rolls back every prior successor, operation row, history fact, and attention source.
transaction.noAsyncGap: The transaction callback is synchronous; no network, publication, browser, or promise boundary can split the commit.

durableEvidence.settlementTable: encounter_settlements stores one revisioned canonical settlement document per encounter with a definition hash and terminal operation binding.
durableEvidence.operationTable: encounter_settlement_operations stores the strict command hash, full private plan evidence, authority hash, exact accepted result, and result hash.
durableEvidence.historyTable: encounter_settlement_history_facts stores immutable audience-scoped structured facts for Experience, loot, captures, outcomes, cleanup, and completion.
durableEvidence.attentionTable: encounter_settlement_attention_sources stores open authority-linked source records without copying mutable character state.
durableEvidence.privacy: Plan evidence, revisions, hashes, operation identities, source identities, and private payloads are server-private. P8-081 owns role-specific projections and realtime publication.

terminalReplay.lookupOrder: A previously accepted operation is loaded before current authority or terminal settlement checks.
terminalReplay.exactness: The same operation identity, strict command hash, and principal returns the stored accepted result byte-for-byte without rerunning mechanics or writes.
terminalReplay.restart: Replay is loaded from SQLite and therefore survives process restart.
terminalReplay.identityReuse: The same operation identity with another command or principal fails closed and never exposes the prior result.
terminalReplay.newOperation: A completed, committing, cancelled, or otherwise terminal settlement cannot be planned or committed under a new operation identity.

attentionAndHistory.history: Facts contain bounded structured result codes and audience scopes; no freeform note becomes hidden mechanics.
attentionAndHistory.levelThreshold: Crossed canonical Experience thresholds seed owner-scoped level-threshold attention sources linked to the exact committed sheet revision and Experience fact.
attentionAndHistory.authorityOnly: Attention sources name an affected entity, reason, source fact, and exact authority reference; they do not copy mutable character data or make irreversible build choices.
attentionAndHistory.futureProcessing: P8-083 and later tickets project and resolve attention items from these durable sources.

tests.rollback: The repository suite injects failure at every generated write boundary and proves all document revisions and evidence tables remain unchanged.
tests.restartReplay: The repository suite closes and reopens a file-backed SQLite database before asserting exact replay without reauthorization.
